title: Scale props
description: A Scale item's props (FR-11, approval-scale-ranking design decision 1): the bounds min and max within a billion either way, an optional step above 0 (1 when absent), an optional range, a display (slider or rating, slider when absent), the labels of its two ends and a unit. What a schema cannot say (max above min, the step dividing the scale into whole steps, at most 1,000 of them, a rating of one value and at most 11 values) is checked by scalePropsProblems. In no schema set until approval-scale-ranking registers it.
